cases.input: Extract a demonstrated procedure into purpose, preconditions, materials, ordered steps, controls, warnings and troubleshooting with timestamp evidence and evidence classes.
requiredBehaviors: classify every element as observed derived or recommended
preserve step evidence timestamps parameters warnings and expected results
mark gaps that require validation before controlled use
forbiddenBehaviors: invent quantities times torque temperatures settings or tolerances
present recommended additions as if stated by the video author
skillAnchors: Jedes Element trägt genau eine Klasse

cases.input: The demonstrated procedure is clear except for one safety-critical temperature value that is visually unreadable.
requiredBehaviors: describe only what is actually visible or inferable
mark the procedure incomplete for controlled use
preserve the missing value as a validation gap
forbiddenBehaviors: call the draft an approved SOP

cases.input: The extractor fills missing values from general knowledge, merges optional variants into one standard and labels the resulting document an effective corporate SOP.
requiredBehaviors: keep variants and optional steps distinct
reject effective/approved corporate status without the controlled workflow
